GOAL: propose exactly one hyperbolic quality metric for exported Stage-2 Semantic-ID tables, contract-compliant, distinct from Q_H, hyp_voronoi_margin_l1, hyp_adj_r2_l1, and the other 4 agents.
READ: workspace listing of my own agent dir only (glob of round/ and of .); attempts to read opencode.json, progress.jsonl, and files outside the agent dir were permission-denied; MCP resources empty. No SID table, no Issue #126 reference, no training split is readable from this sandbox.
OBSERVED: only running.json, session.jsonl, stderr.log, opencode.json, progress.jsonl exist locally; no data files. Therefore the metric must be designed from the contract text and the stated 97-pair measurements, not fitted to accessible data.
EVIDENCE: glob outputs above; permission.rejected on read of local and external files; empty MCP resource list.
REASONING: the only hard facts are Q_H(level1)=+0.634, Q_H(level2)=+0.287, Q_H(level3)=+0.393, bucket count=-0.065, same-bucket weak; Voronoi margin and adjacent-level R^2 already failed. Any winning construction must use the frozen reference's curved geometry but must condition per-parent so that near-unique deep prefixes neither inflate nor collapse the score. I will avoid local margins, R^2 of distances, prefix counts, collision/same-bucket ratios, and silhouette/dispersion re-expressions.
OPEN: finalize the exact formula, barycentre definition, constants, and compute cost.

ANSWER CHOICE (complete answer is in the final chat reply): hyp_hsoftmax_path = mean over TRAINING pairs and SID levels of the log tree-conditional softmax probability of the true next code, with logits = -d_H(s_u, mu(q,c))/tau. d_H is the intrinsic Poincare distance (curvature -1 after rescaling the reference's K); mu(q,c) is a closed-form Lorentz/hyperboloid barycentre of the frozen target reps of all items under prefix q^(c); tau is the reference's own temperature. Nodes with one child contribute 0, so near-unique deep prefixes cannot inflate/degrade the score.
INPUTS: SID table; frozen reference source/target reps; reference tau and K; TRAINING split only. No val/test interaction, no recall, no Stage-3 run.
WHY: it emulates beam search over the SID trie and conditions per parent, so it measures refinement quality at every level rather than global level-1 prefix ranking (Q_H). It is a likelihood, not a margin (hyp_voronoi_margin_l1) and not an R^2 of distances (hyp_adj_r2_l1), and it is not a prefix count / collision / same-bucket ratio.
COST: O(N L d + |T| L B) with B = mean sibling branching; one vectorised numpy pass, seconds to under a minute at N=24587, V=256.
RISK: assumes source and target reps share one Poincare ball; in-sample training pairs; tau/K misreport; shallow L=1 degenerates to a level-1 term.
FAILURE MODE: random level-1 assignment with deterministic singleton deeper levels (all g_l=0, random prototypes), i.e. high apparent branching/counts but no behavioural grouping.
This record is a summary only; the full formula and symbol definitions are in the last assistant message.
